title: The one-sided loss
description: `binary_cross_entropy(p, y)` should return the mean binary cross-entropy. A model trained with it learns to predict 1 for everything. Find the missing piece.
explanation: BCE has two terms: -[y log p + (1 - y) log(1 - p)]. Dropping the (1 - y) term means negative examples contribute no loss, so predicting 1 everywhere looks perfect. The loss must also clip p away from 0 and 1.
